## Installation

1. Download and install the [Ultimate ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases) into the folder of the game, where `SR2_pc.exe` is located.
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for Saints Row 2](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/sr2/SR2.XboxRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` and `.ini` files into the `scripts` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- Works with the Direct3D 9 renderer of the game.
- The ini is watched while the game runs, so its settings can be changed and tested without restarting.
